artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for all three phases of the literature-retrieve.sh upgrade

completion_data.completion_summary: Upgraded literature-retrieve.sh to read TOKEN_BUDGET from index.json (default 8000, was hardcoded 4000), discover and normalize subdirectory chapters[] indexes into the unified scoring pool, and deduplicate merged entries with root-wins precedence; both script copies are byte-identical.

memory_candidates.content: literature-retrieve.sh chapters[] normalization pattern: subdirectory index.json files use a 'chapters' array with a 'file' field instead of 'entries' array with a 'path' field. Normalize with jq: map({id: ($subdir + "_" + .file), path: ($subdir + "/" + .file), title: .title, token_count: .token_count, keywords: (.keywords // []), summary: (.summary // "")}). Use find -maxdepth 2 -name index.json ! -path "$INDEX_FILE" for one-level-deep discovery.
